### Key Verified Statistics (2026-11-24)
- Total SaaS & AI leaders audited: 112 (Mean Security Score: 80.8/100)
- Strict DMARC enforcement (p=reject): 74/112 (66.1%); Quarantine: 36/112 (32.1%); None/Missing: 2/112
- Sector Gap — Fintech & HR vs AI & LLM: 12/12 (100.0%) of Fintech & HR leaders enforce DMARC p=reject, whereas only 11/24 (45.8%) of leading AI & LLM vendors enforce DMARC p=reject.
- DNS CAA Adoption: 51/112 (45.5%) overall; Security & GRC sector sits at 4/14 (28.6%).
- Strict SPF Hard-Fail (-all): 39/112 (34.8%).
- Trust Center GRC Adoption (70/112 = 62.5% detected via DNS CNAME):
  - Vanta: 29 vendors (25.9% of all 112, 41.4% of detected Trust Centers)
  - SafeBase + Drata: 22 vendors (19.6%)
  - Custom / Self-Hosted Trust Subdomains: 14 vendors (12.5%)
  - Conveyor: 4 vendors; Whistic: 1 vendor
  - No DNS Trust Subdomain Detected: 42 vendors (37.5%)
- Email Infrastructure: Google Workspace 96/112 (85.7%), Proofpoint Enterprise 11/112 (9.8%), Microsoft 365 2/112.
